budget_items.topic: Debt service policy limits on regular borrowing
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town's financial policies cap total debt service of regular borrowing at the lower of 4% of the total tax levy or three percent of the Town's budget in a fiscal year.
budget_items.quote: total debt service costs of regular borrowing should not exceed 4% of the total tax levy, or three percent of the town's budget in a fiscal year, whichever is lower.
